sys_update_xml.name: sp_page_ab89c94ebd0c53107f4415c9e4eed5ae
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_page"><sp_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><css>/* Hero sits flush under the header */
main.body.padding-top { padding-top: 0; }

/* Three-column layout: stats | tiles | article */
.fn-stats-layout { padding-top: 24px; }
@media (min-width: 992px) {
  .fn-stats-layout > .container-fluid > sp-page-row > .row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; }
  .fn-stats-layout > .container-fluid > sp-page-row > .row > .col-md-3:first-child { flex: 0 0 220px; width: 220px; max-width: 220px; padding-left: 24px; }
  .fn-stats-layout > .container-fluid > sp-page-row > .row > .col-md-6 { flex: 1 1 auto; width: auto; }
  .fn-stats-layout > .container-fluid > sp-page-row > .row > .col-md-6 .row { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .fn-stats-layout > .container-fluid > sp-page-row > .row > .col-md-3:last-child { flex: 0 0 340px; width: 340px; max-width: 340px; padding-right: 24px; }
}

/* Stats: flat, informational readouts */
.fn-stats-layout .report-widget-wrap {
  background: rgba(62, 27, 47, 0.05);
  border: 0;
  border-left: 4px solid #F2A93B;
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: none;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  text-align: left;
  pointer-events: none;
  cursor: default;
}
.fn-stats-layout .report-widget-title {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  margin: 0 0 2px;
  opacity: .65;
}

/* Action tiles: clearly clickable cards */
.fn-stats-layout .iconlink a.top_icon {
  display: block;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid rgba(62, 27, 47, 0.12);
  border-radius: 16px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(62, 27, 47, 0.10);
  padding: 28px 20px 24px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
}
.fn-stats-layout .iconlink a.top_icon:hover,
.fn-stats-layout .iconlink a.top_icon:focus {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(62, 27, 47, 0.18);
  border-color: #F2A93B;
  text-decoration: none;
}

/* My matches: full-width bar under the tiles */
.fn-stats-layout .col-md-12 .iconlink a.top_icon {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  background: #3A1B2A;
  border-color: #3A1B2A;
}
.fn-stats-layout .col-md-12 .iconlink a.top_icon .fa { font-size: 32px !important; margin: 0 !important; color: #F2A93B !important; }
.fn-stats-layout .col-md-12 .iconlink a.top_icon h2 { margin: 0; color: #F7EFE6; font-size: 22px; }
.fn-stats-layout .col-md-12 .iconlink a.top_icon .text-muted { color: #EADBE0 !important; margin-left: 8px; }
.fn-stats-layout .col-md-12 .iconlink a.top_icon:hover { background: #6A3D52; border-color: #F2A93B; }

/* Newspaper clipping */
.fn-paper {
  background: #FFFAF4;
  border: 1px solid #EBDCCB;
  border-top: 4px double #3A1B2A;
  padding: 20px 22px 18px;
  font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  color: #2E1620;
}
.fn-paper-kicker { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6B4E4A; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.fn-paper-head { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.15; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 6px; color: #2E1620; }
.fn-paper-date { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #6B4E4A; border-bottom: 1px solid #EBDCCB; padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.fn-paper-body { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; margin: 0 0 10px; text-align: justify; }
.fn-dropcap { float: left; font-size: 44px; line-height: 36px; padding: 4px 6px 0 0; font-weight: 700; color: #A8521C; }
.fn-paper-link { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #A8521C; }




/* FeedNow background — target the actual portal page */
html,
body,
body #page,
body .sp-page-root {
  background-color: #fff8f0 !important;
  background-image: url('https://sya-oct-1140-0004.lab.service-now.com/x_1234_feednow.feednow%20bg.png') !important;
  background-size: cover !important;
  background-position: center top !important;
  background-repeat: no-repeat !important;
  background-attachment: fixed !important;
}

/* Keep the homepage layout transparent */
.fn-stats-layout,
.fn-stats-layout > .container-fluid {

function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }

    var selectedTime = getDateFromFormat(
        newValue,
        g_user_date_time_format
    );

    if (selectedTime == 0) {
        g_form.showFieldMsg(
            'needed_by_date',
            'Please enter a valid pickup date and time.',
            'error'
        );
        return;
    }

    var now = new Date().getTime();

    if (selectedTime < now) {
        g_form.clearValue('needed_by_date');
        g_form.showFieldMsg(
            'needed_by_date',
            'Needed by date and time must be now or in the future.',
            'error'
        );
    } else {
        g_form.hideFieldMsg('needed_by_date', true);
    }
}
]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>Anjali</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-21 18:34:49</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>0507f04ebd4853107f4415c9e4eed5f1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Validate Needed by date</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="FeedNow " source="x_1234_feednow">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FeedNow ">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_0507f04ebd4853107f4415c9e4eed5f1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>Anjali</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-21 19:32:54</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

    var selected = g_form.getValue('u_needed_by');

    if (!selected)

    if (selectedDate.before(currentDate)) {

    }

    return true;

sys_update_xml.name: sp_theme_92f13cc9a58813107f4483acc6c6a172
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_theme"><sp_theme action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css_variables>/* ============================================================
   FeedNow · Fig & Apricot — Service Portal THEME VARIABLES
   Paste into: Service Portal > Themes > [FeedNow] > "CSS variables"
   These override the portal's built-in Bootstrap variables.
   ============================================================ */

/* ---- Palette ---- */
$fn-fig:          #3A1B2A;   /* header, dark panels */
$fn-fig-light:    #6A3D52;   /* logo ring track, nav hover */
$fn-apricot:      #A8521C;   /* primary buttons, links */
$fn-apricot-dark: #8C4415;   /* button hover */
$fn-apricot-light:#E58A3A;   /* accents, urgent bars (not for text) */
$fn-saffron:      #F2A93B;   /* active nav, "Post surplus" button */
$fn-ink:          #2E1620;   /* body text */
$fn-cream:        #F7EFE6;   /* page background */
$fn-card:         #FFFAF4;   /* cards, panels */
$fn-line:         #EBDCCB;   /* borders, dividers */
$fn-muted:        #6B4E4A;   /* secondary text */

/* ---- Bootstrap / Service Portal overrides ---- */
$brand-primary:   $fn-apricot;
$brand-success:   #6A4405;
$brand-info:      $fn-fig-light;
$brand-warning:   #8A4B05;
$brand-danger:    #8A3E0C;

$body-bg:          $fn-cream;
$text-color:       $fn-ink;
$text-muted:       $fn-muted;
$link-color:       $fn-apricot;
$link-hover-color: $fn-apricot-dark;

$font-family-sans-serif: 'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
$headings-font-family:   'Bricolage Grotesque', 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
$headings-font-weight:   700;
$headings-color:         $fn-ink;
$font-size-base:         16px;

$border-radius-base:  10px;
$border-radius-large: 14px;
$border-radius-small: 8px;

/* Header (Service Portal uses the inverse navbar) */
$navbar-inverse-bg:                $fn-fig;
$navbar-inverse-border:            $fn-fig;
$navbar-inverse-color:             #EADBE0;
$navbar-inverse-link-color:        #EADBE0;
$navbar-inverse-link-hover-color:  #FFFFFF;
$navbar-inverse-link-hover-bg:     $fn-fig-light;
$navbar-inverse-link-active-color: $fn-ink;
$navbar-inverse-link-active-bg:    $fn-saffron;
$navbar-inverse-brand-color:       $fn-cream;

/* Buttons */
$btn-primary-bg:     $fn-apricot;
$btn-primary-border: $fn-apricot;
$btn-primary-color:  #FFFFFF;
$btn-default-bg:     $fn-card;
$btn-default-border: $fn-apricot;
$btn-default-color:  $fn-apricot;

/* Panels & inputs */
$panel-bg:                 $fn-card;
$panel-default-border:     $fn-line;
$panel-default-heading-bg: $fn-card;
$input-border:             #D8C6B4;
$input-border-focus:       $fn-apricot;
$input-border-radius:      10px;
$list-group-bg:            $fn-card;
$list-group-border:        $fn-line;

</css_variables><footer/><footer_fixed>false</footer_fixed><header display_value="Stock Header">bf5ec2f2cb10120000f8d856634c9c0c</header><icon/><logo/><logo_alt_text/><matching_now_experience_theme/><name>FeedNow</name><navbar_fixed>false</navbar_fixed><sys_class_name>sp_theme</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>Brittany</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-18 15:46:07</sys_created_on><sys_id>92f13cc9a58813107f4483acc6c6a172</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>FeedNow</sys_name><sys_package display_value="FeedNow " source="x_1234_feednow">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FeedNow ">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_theme_92f13cc9a58813107f4483acc6c6a172</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>Brittany</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-19 13:56:01</sys_updated_on><turn_off_scss_compilation>false</turn_off_scss_compilation></sp_theme><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=92f13cc9a58813107f4483acc6c6a172"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sp_css_2ec4f441a5c813107f4483acc6c6a161
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>/* ============================================================
   FeedNow Â· Fig & Apricot â€” Service Portal STYLESHEET
   Create via sp_css.list > New (name: feednow-theme),
   then add to your theme: Themes > [FeedNow] > CSS Includes > New.
   Load fonts with a separate CSS Include (Source: URL) â€” see notes.
   ============================================================ */

:root {
  --fn-fig: #3A1B2A;
  --fn-fig-light: #6A3D52;
  --fn-apricot: #A8521C;
  --fn-apricot-dark: #8C4415;
  --fn-apricot-light: #E58A3A;
  --fn-saffron: #F2A93B;
  --fn-ink: #2E1620;
  --fn-cream: #F7EFE6;
  --fn-card: #FFFAF4;
  --fn-line: #EBDCCB;
  --fn-muted: #6B4E4A;

  /* status pills */
  --fn-hot-bg: #FBE1C9;   --fn-hot-text: #8A3E0C;   /* urgent / breach */
  --fn-ok-bg: #F6E7C6;    --fn-ok-text: #6A4405;    /* open / claimed */
  --fn-warn-bg: #FCEBCB;  --fn-warn-text: #8A4B05;  /* SLA warning */
}

/* ---------- Base ---------- */
body {
  background: var(--fn-cream);
  color: var(--fn-ink);
  font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
}
h1, h2, h3, h4, .fn-display {
  font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  color: var(--fn-ink);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}
a { color: var(--fn-apricot); }
a:hover, a:focus { color: var(--fn-apricot-dark); }

/* ---------- Header ---------- */
.navbar, .navbar-inverse {
  background: var(--fn-fig);
  border: 0;
}
.navbar .navbar-brand {
  font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 21px;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--fn-cream);
}

/* stop the header from clipping the FeedNow title */
.navbar-header,
.navbar-brand,
.navbar-brand * {
  width: auto !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  overflow: visible !important;
  text-overflow: clip !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
}
.navbar-brand { padding-left: 20px !important; padding-right: 24px !important; }
.navbar .navbar-brand .fn-now { color: var(--fn-saffron); } /* wrap "Now" in <span class="fn-now"> */
.navbar-inverse .navbar-nav > li > a {
  color: #EADBE0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.navbar-inverse .navbar-nav > li > a:hover { background: var(--fn-fig-light); color: #FFFFFF; }
.navbar-inverse .navbar-nav > .active > a,
.navbar-inverse .navbar-nav > .active > a:hover {
  background: var(--fn-saffron);
  color: var(--fn-ink);
}

/* ---------- Buttons ---------- */
.btn { border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 700; min-height: 44px; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--fn-apricot); border-color: var(--fn-apricot); color: #FFFFFF; }
.btn-primary:hover, .btn-primary:focus { background: var(--fn-apricot-dark); border-color: var(--fn-apricot-dark); color: #FFFFFF; }
.btn-default { background: var(--fn-card); border-color: var(--fn-apricot); color: var(--fn-apricot); }
.btn-default:hover { background: var(--fn-hot-bg); }
.btn-fn-post {               /* "Post surplus food" call to action */
  background: var(--fn-saffron);
  border-color: var(--fn-saffron);
  color: var(--fn-ink);
}
.btn-fn-post:hover { background: #E0962A; border-color: #E0962A; color: var(--fn-ink); }

/* ---------- Cards / panels ---------- */
.panel, .fn-card {
  background: var(--fn-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-line);
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.panel-heading { background: transparent; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--fn-line); }
.fn-card { padding: 20px; }
.fn-card-dark {
  background: var(--fn-fig);
  color: var(--fn-cream);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 20px;
}
.text-muted, .fn-muted { color: var(--fn-muted); }

/* ---------- Status pills (listing timers, SLA states) ---------- */
.fn-pill {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.fn-pill-urgent  { background: var(--fn-hot-bg);  color: var(--fn-hot-text); }
.fn-pill-open    { background: var(--fn-ok-bg);   color: var(--fn-ok-text); }
.fn-pill-warning { background: var(--fn-warn-bg); color: var(--fn-warn-text); }

/* Filter chips */
.fn-chip {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--fn-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-line);
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--fn-ink);
}
.fn-chip.active { background: var(--fn-ink); color: var(--fn-card); border-color: var(--fn-ink); }

/* Countdown bar */
.fn-bar { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--fn-line); overflow: hidden; }
.fn-bar > span { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--fn-apricot); }
.fn-bar.urgent > span { background: var(--fn-apricot-light); }

/* ---------- Forms ---------- */
.form-control {
  min-height: 44px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border-color: #D8C6B4;
  background: #FFFFFF;
  color: var(--fn-ink);
}
.form-control:focus {
  border-color: var(--fn-apricot);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(168, 82, 28, 0.2);
}

/* ---------- Footer ---------- */
.fn-footer { background: var(--fn-fig); color: var(--fn-cream); padding: 24px 0; }

/* let the FeedNow title fit */
.navbar-brand,
.navbar-header .navbar-brand {
  width: auto !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  overflow: visible !important;
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding-right: 24px;
}

/* hide the Guided Tours link in the header */
.navbar .gtd-dropdown-container,
#tour-dropdown {
  display: none !important;
}</css><name>feednow-theme</name><sys_class_name>sp_css</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>Brittany</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-18 15:48:51</sys_created_on><sys_id>2ec4f441a5c813107f4483acc6c6a161</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>feednow-theme</sys_name><sys_package display_value="FeedNow " source="x_1234_feednow">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FeedNow ">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_css_2ec4f441a5c813107f4483acc6c6a161</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>Brittany</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-19 14:04:10</sys_updated_on><turn_off_scss_compilation>false</turn_off_scss_compilation></sp_css></record_update>

Urgent requests run on a shorter clock and alert the coordinator right away.</p><p class=\"fn-paper-body\">Once submitted, FeedNow looks for an available listing of the same food type. When one is found, the request moves to Matched and both the recipient and the donor are notified with each other's pickup details.</p><a class=\"fn-paper-link\" href=\"?id=kb_article&sys_id=da6e6e16604093107f443e266efee150\">Read the full article →</a></article>","displayValue":"<article class=\"fn-paper\"><div class=\"fn-paper-kicker\">From the FeedNow knowledge base</div><h3 class=\"fn-paper-head\">How to Submit a Food Request</h3><div class=\"fn-paper-date\">KB0001002 · Published Oct 22, 2026</div><p class=\"fn-paper-body\"><span class=\"fn-dropcap\">R</span>ecipients such as shelters, pantries and community fridges tell FeedNow what they need: the type of food, how many servings, and when it is needed by. Urgent requests run on a shorter clock and alert the coordinator right away.</p><p class=\"fn-paper-body\">Once submitted, FeedNow looks for an available listing of the same food type. When one is found, the request moves to Matched and both the recipient and the donor are notified with each other's pickup details.</p><a class=\"fn-paper-link\" href=\"?id=kb_article&sys_id=da6e6e16604093107f443e266efee150\">Read the full article →</a></article>"}}]]></widget_parameters></sp_instance><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=4a16a2e2c14413107f44147b7859869e"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_1234_feednow_donor</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="x_1234_feednow_donor">statusVALCHANGES^EQ<item display_value="-- None --" endquery="false" field="status" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Donor group sync</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    var GROUP_NAME = 'FeedNow Donors';

    var group = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
    if (!group.get('name', GROUP_NAME)) {
        gs.error('Group sync: group not found: ' + GROUP_NAME);
        return;
    }

    var member = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
    member.addQuery('group', group.getUniqueValue());
    member.addQuery('user', current.primary_contact);
    member.query();

    if (current.status == 'approved') {
        if (!member.next()) {
            member.initialize();
            member.group = group.getUniqueValue();
            member.user = current.primary_contact;
            member.insert();
        }
    } else {
        while (member.next()) {
            member.deleteRecord();
        }
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>John</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-25 15:13:44</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>902eac53618813107f44171937e61df8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Donor group sync</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="FeedNow " source="x_1234_feednow">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FeedNow ">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_902eac53618813107f44171937e61df8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>John</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-25 15:13:44</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=902eac53618813107f44171937e61df8"/></record_update>
